text:
#!name=苏打校园APP
#!desc=fmz200/wool_scripts · 某些APP要清除缓存或者重新安装拦截广告才会生效！
#!author=奶思

[MITM]
hostname = api.sodalife.xyz

[Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.sodalife\.xyz\/v1\/posters\?location=SODA_APP%3AHOME%3ABOTTOM/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.sodalife\.xyz\/v1\/posters\?location=SODA_APP%3AHOME%3ACENTER/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.sodalife\.xyz\/v1\/posters\?location=SODA_APP%3AMINE%3ABOTTOM/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.sodalife\.xyz\/v1\/posters\?location=SODA_APP%3AREWARDS%3ACENTER/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.sodalife\.xyz\/v1\/goods/i then reject_dict(200)

[Script]
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/api\.sodalife\.xyz\/v1\/posters\?location=SODA_APP%3AHOME%3ATOP/i then script("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fmz200/wool_scripts/main/Scripts/soda.js") with enable=${sudaxnyr_enable}, tag="苏打校园APP", timeout=60, requires_body=true
